text: PDF4All is a feasibility spike for a local-first desktop PDF application. Every page of this
fixture carries the same self-authored ASCII paragraph so that full-document text
extraction, search and rendering can be measured on a document with a realistic page count
and a realistic number of content-stream operators. No third-party document was used to
build it, and the generator is checked in next to the file it produces.

provenance.authorship: written by the project team for this spike (ds2)
provenance.third_party_content: none; the paragraph is self-authored ASCII
provenance.fonts: Base-14 Helvetica reference only, no font program embedded

extraction_contract.mupdf_1.28.1: countPages() === 500; search('PDF4All') returns exactly two hits per page (header line plus the paragraph opener); every page renders non-blank
